title: Senior Analyst, Inventory Operations
description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

StackAdapt is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by the world's most performance-driven marketers. As we scale our supply-side partnerships and deepen inventory intelligence, we're looking for a Senior Analyst, Inventory Operations to join our Advertising Technologies team. 

This role is central to how we manage, analyze, and grow our inventory ecosystem across key supply partners. This role works closely with Product, Engineering, Revenue Operations, and external supply partners to ensure inventory health, supply quality, and analytical insights flow seamlessly across the organization.

StackAdapt is a Remote First company; we are open to candidates located anywhere in Canada for this position.

What You'll Be Doing:

• Own end-to-end analysis across multiple data sources (MariaDB, StarRocks, Snowflake, Redshift) and translate findings into clear recommendations for leadership and cross-functional partners

• Serve as the senior escalation point for complex campaign delivery and supply issues on high-value accounts, driving root-cause analysis and preventing repeat issues

• Design and deliver scalable automation for recurring inventory workflows, including deal setup validation, supply audits, and reporting, using SQL, Python, and AI-assisted tooling

• Partner with Inventory Development, Technical Program, and Product teams to shape commercialization strategy, surface supply gaps, and influence the product roadmap with data

• Guide the Sales team on complex RFPs, recommending inventory, measurement, and data solutions and building the analysis that supports them

• Define and maintain team standards for data quality, documentation, and troubleshooting playbooks

• Identify supply trends, pricing shifts, and performance opportunities proactively, and bring recommendations to leadership before they're requested

What You'll Bring to the Table

• 3+ years of experience in analytics, operations, or a data-focused role within ad tech, programmatic, or a related field

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field or equivalent practical experience

• Proven track record of leading data projects end to end, from scoping through delivery and adoption

• Expert-level SQL and strong experience working with large, complex datasets across multiple systems

• Hands-on experience with data platforms and BI tools such as StarRocks, Snowflake, Redshift, ThoughtSpot, or Elasticsearch/Kibana

• Ability to explain detailed technical analyses to technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Expertise in working with RTB, DSPs, SSPs and other platforms is a plus

• Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the judgment to prioritize across competing high-impact issues

• Python, scripting, or experience building AI-assisted workflows is a plus

 

The compensation range listed for this role reflects the expected base salary for candidates located in the posting country based on a global rate. It is informed by market data and the approved budget for this position. StackAdapt maintains different compensation ranges for roles across other countries and regions, and final offers will be aligned to the candidate’s current location. We do not ask c andidates about current or prior salary history, and we will not use such information, if volunteered, in setting an offer.

This range represents base salary only. Depending on the role, candidates may also be eligible for additional compensation such as annual bonuses, commissions,

title: Mortgage Loan Processor
description:

The company is a premier New Zealand mortgage advisory firm dedicated to guiding first-home buyers, existing homeowners, and property investors through customized lending, refinancing, restructuring, and property-finance solutions. Operating across the end-to-end mortgage lifecycle-from initial inquiry and application preparation to approval, settlement, refixing, and ongoing lending reviews-the company delivers exceptional service and trusted expertise to clients across the region.

We are seeking a high-caliber Mortgage Loan Processor to provide comprehensive, end-to-end operational and administrative support to our Company Director and Mortgage Advisers. In this high-impact role, you will take ownership of client file management, verify application documentation, maintain MYCRM and NZFSG systems, and coordinate directly with lenders, conveyancers, and clients.
Your core objective is to drive pipeline efficiency, accelerate application turnaround times, eliminate administrative bottlenecks for advisers, and maintain an exceptional, high-touch experience for our clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Loan Processing & Application Preparation

• Conduct rigorous pre-submission audits on home loan applications, verify completeness against strict checklists, and validate supporting documentation (ID, income, bank statements, liabilities, assets, property data).

• Manage post-settlement relationship touchpoints, including executing client review schedules, refix-review reminders, birthday communications, and Google review requests.

File, CRM & Document Management

• Manage electronic client files in strict compliance with standardized file naming, folder hierarchy, and version-control protocols.

• Maintain real-time, comprehensive records, file notes, and activity logs across MYCRM and NZFSG platforms.

• Routinely audit pipeline files to ensure zero missed deadlines, outstanding conditions, or untracked compliance requirements.

• Safeguard sensitive personal and financial data in alignment with strict privacy and security standards.

Stakeholder Coordination & Adviser Support

• Interface directly with lenders, banks, conveyancers, solicitors, real estate agents, and valuers to track progress, resolve conditions, order property valuations, and manage pricing/discharge requests.

• Support advisers with comparative lending option summaries, strategy preparation, and client meeting documentation.

• Oversee executive administrative functions for the Company Director, including inbox management, calendar/appointment scheduling, and client contact database maintenance in Microsoft Outlook.

• Collaborate on continuous improvement initiatives to refine checklists, standard operating procedures, and administrative workflows.

Industry Experience : Demonstrated background in New Zealand mortgage administration, loan processing, broker support, or banking/financial services administration.

•
Systems Proficiency : Proven, hands-on experience utilizing MYCRM and NZFSG platforms is strictly required.

•
Technical Knowledge : Deep working knowledge of the New Zealand residential home-loan application lifecycle and document verific

title: Оператор вхідної лінії контактного центру банку (дистанційно)
description:
Райффайзен Банк - найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом. Більше 30 років ми створюємо та вибудовуємо банківську систему нашої держави.
У Райфі працює понад 5 тисяч співробітників, серед них одна із найбільших продуктових ІТ-команд, що налічує 900+ фахівців. Щодня пліч-о-пліч ми працюємо, щоб більш ніж 2,5 мільйона наших клієнтів могли отримати якісне обслуговування, користуватися продуктами і сервісами банку, розвивати бізнес, адже ми #Разом_з_Україною. 

Твої майбутні обов’язки: 

• Допомагати клієнтам у буденних банківських справах, пояснювати складні речі простими словами

• Знати і пропонувати клієнтам додаткові банківські продукти та послуги

Як виглядає робота в Райфі? Подивись відео з АІ-гідом, який пояснить усе просто і зрозуміло:
Твій досвід та навич ки: 

• Вільно володієш українською мовою

• Маєш навички роботи з комп’ютером

• Маєш додаткові засоби живлення та стабільний інтернет під час відключення світла

• Готовий допомагати клієнтам Райфу

• Швидко навчаєшся та легко сприймаєш великий обсяг інформації

• Легко знаходиш спільну мову з різними людьми

• Вмієш ефективно працювати в команді

• Можеш просто пояснювати складні речі

Пропонуємо те, що має значення саме для тебе: 

•
Конкурентна заробітна плата : гарантуємо стабільний дохід. Додатково, у нас діє реферальна програма винагороди за залучення нових колег до Райффайзен Банку.

•
Соціальний пакет: офіційне працевлаштування, 28 днів оплачуваної відпустки, додатковий «декрет» для татусів, та матеріальна допомога для батьків при народженні дітей.

•
Комфортні умови праці: віддалений формат роботи з можливістю працювати з будь-якого куточка України, забезпечення сучасною технікою.
(засоби живлення і стабільний інтернет забезпечуєш самостійно)
Перший місяць роботи пн-пт з 9:00 до 18:00
Далі 5\2 з плаваючими вихідними по 4\6\8 годин ( є нічні зміни)

•
Wellbeing програма: для всіх співробітників доступні медичне страхування з першого робочого дня; консультації психолога, нутриціолога чи юриста; дисконт програми на спорт та покупки; family days для дітей та дорослих; масаж в офісі.

•
Навчання та розвиток: повний супровід на старті (онбординг); тренерський центр для розвитку навичок; доступ до понад 130 навчальних онлайн-ресурсів; програма менторства; онлайн-бібліотека.

•
Крута команда: наші колеги - це спільнота, де вітаються допитливість, талант та інновації. Ми підтримуємо один одного, вчимося разом та зростаємо. Ти можеш знайти однодумців у понад 15-ти професійних ком’юніті, читацькому чи спортивному клубах.

•
Кар'єрні можливості: ми заохочуємо просування всередині банку між функціями.

•
Програма підтримки захисників і захисниць: ми зберігаємо робочі місця та виплачуємо середню заробітну плату мобілізованим. Для ветеранів та ветеранок у нас діє програма підтримки, розвивається ветеранська спільнота Банку. Ми працюємо над підвищенням обізнаності керівників та команд з питань повернення ветеранів до цивільного життя. Райффайзен Банк відзначений як один з найкращих роботодавців для ветеранів (Forbes).

Чому Райффайзен Банк?  Наша головна цінність - люди і ми даємо їм підтримку і визнання, навчаємо, залучаємо до змін. Приєднуйся до команди Райфу, адже для нас ТИ маєш значення! 

• Один із найбільших кредиторів економіки та аграрного бізнесу серед приватних банків 

• Визнаний найкращим працедавцем за версіями EY, Forbes, Robota.ua, Stud-Point, Delo.UA, NV, Odgers, UAFIC

• Найбільший донор гуманітарної допомоги серед банків (Червоний Хрест України, UNITED24, Superhumans, СМІЛИВІ) 

• Одна з найбільших ІТ-продуктових команд серед банків країни 

• Один із найбільших платників податків в Україні, за 2025 рік було нараховано 6 млрд гривень

Можливості для всіх:

• Райф керується принципами, що фокусуються на людині та її розвитку, у центрі уваги понад 5 тисяч співробітників та 2,5 мільйона клієнтів  

• Підтримуємо принципи різноманіття, рівності та інклюзивності.

• Ми відкриті до найму ветеранів і людей з інвалідністю та готові адаптувати робоче сере

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. title: Customer Growth Marketing Manager - EMEA
description:
About Zensai

Zensai is the Human Success company. Our agentic AI platform coaches employees and managers through learning, performance, and engagement, natively inside Microsoft 365. More than 2,000 organizations use Zensai to make development part of how work happens, rather than a separate HR destination.
We believe the more AI we have, the more human we need to be. This role is where that belief meets our customers.
Why this role exists
Our biggest growth opportunity sits with the customers we already have. Over the next few years we plan to grow 3.6x from our existing customer base - and that growth depends on customers who stay, adopt more, and move up our editions.
You are Marketing's person in EMEA for that customer base. You know our customers in the region better than anyone in Marketing: who they are, what they're trying to achieve, where they're thriving, and where they're at risk. You turn that understanding into programs that keep customers engaged, grow accounts, and surface the stories that help us win more.
This is a marketing role that shows up with Sales. Under our go-to-market model, each region runs as a cross-functional pod - AEs, AMs, CSMs, solution and GTM engineers, and marketing - aligned around the customer. You're a member of the EMEA pod: in customer meetings, in sales meetings, and in the room when regional priorities are set. You know the region's objectives as well as the people carrying the number.
This is a generalist customer marketing role with a commercial number attached. You'll work hand in hand with Customer Success and Account Managers in the region, alongside our Lifecycle Marketing Manager and the central marketing team.
Where you sit
Solid line - Marketing - priorities, standards, brand and messaging, performance review, career development
Dotted line - VP Sales, EMEA - regional revenue priorities, target accounts, program focus
Closest partners - Customer Success Managers and Account Managers in EMEA · Lifecycle Marketing Manager · Product Marketing · Brand & Content · GTM Engineering
Counterpart - Customer Growth Marketing Manager, NA - one shared playbook, two regions
Regional pod - AEs, AMs, CSMs, SE/GTM Engineer, BDR, Channel in North America
Cadence you join - Weekly working session with the VP · weekly pipeline review and forecast call · weekly account and renewal review with CS and AMs · customer and sales meetings · monthly regional business review · quarterly planning with central marketing
Where regional and central priorities conflict, Marketing leadership and the RVP resolve it together. You flag early rather than absorb the trade-off.
What you own

• The regional customer strategy - the EMEA customer marketing plan, set with the RVP and regional commercial leadership.

• Expansion pipeline and ARR influenced by your programs in EMEA.

• Retention contribution - at-risk accounts reached and re-engaged before renewal.

• Customer stories - a steady supply of case studies, references, reviews, and speakers from the region.

• Program performance - what worked, what didn't, and what we do next, reported monthly.

What you'll do
Set the regional strategy

• Own the plan: set the EMEA customer marketing strategy in partnership with the VP, regional sales, and commercial leadership - which customers, which industries, which programs, and what each should deliver.

• Tie it to the number: build the plan from the region's revenue, renewal, and expansion objectives, and revisit it every quarter.

• Report back: bring program-sourced pipeline, expansion ARR influenced, and retention results into each regional business review.

Show up with Sales

• In the meetings: join customer meetings, account planning, pipeline reviews, and forecast calls - so programs are built against live regional priorities, not a central calendar.

• Run the matrix cadence: hold a standing weekly working session with the RVP to agree priorities, target accounts, and success measures.

Clinician Engagement is a new function at DataSpring , created to deepen the relationship between DataSpring and the clinicians and provider organizations who contribute to and rely on our data. The function exists to increase trust and positive perception within the clinician user community, improve the quality of the data clinicians provide, and grow the volume of clinicians in our database, including the number who are active and attested.

The Director, Clinician Engagement leads this function. The position builds and stewards the forums where clinicians and provider staff shape our direction, develops partnerships with the provider organizations clinicians already trust, and serves as DataSpring 's internal subject matter expert on clinician perspective. The role accelerates the reach and credibility of work already underway across Marketing, Product, and Insights by bringing clinician voice and clinician relationships to it.

This is role spans strategy and execution. The Director sets direction and holds the senior relationships, and also does the hands-on work of running councils, managing partner relationships week to week, and synthesizing what clinicians say into direction the rest of the organization can act on. Success depends on convening the right clinicians, earning their sustained participation, and closing the loop so they see their input reflected in what DataSpring builds and says.

title: Senior Engineer II, Robotics Mechanical Design
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Our Platform Evaluation team tests and benchmarks alternative robotics platforms, including mobile manipulators, AMRs/AGVs, and other form factors, against our current production baseline. The team builds custom mobile manipulators by combining off-the-shelf components from different AMR and robot arm manufacturers, for example mounting one or more arms from a given vendor onto an AMR base from another.

As the Robotics Mechanical Design Engineer, you will own the mechanical design of these custom configurations end to end: mocking up multiple iterations (different arm brands, mounting positions, and configurations), modeling them fully in CAD, and preparing designs for simulation and physical build.

You will work closely with the Platform Evaluation engineers, who validate designs in simulation (NVIDIA Isaac Sim) and in physical testing once built. This is a hands-on mechanical and mechatronic design role, not a robotics software or controls position.

What You'll Be Building

• Design and iterate mounting and integration concepts combining robot arms with AMR/AGV base platforms

• Produce multiple design options per platform combination for evaluation

• Model custom mobile manipulator configurations in CAD, including brackets, structural supports, and interface hardware

• Run mass, center-of-gravity, and payload analysis to keep configurations within manufacturer specifications

• Design cable, hose, and connector routing between the arm, end effector, and AMR base

• Prepare simulation-ready CAD models and specifications (exportable URDF/mesh geometry) for Isaac Sim validation

Introduction
Blockchain is a system of recording information in a way that makes it difficult or impossible to change, hack, or cheat the system.
A blockchain is essentially a digital ledger of transactions that is duplicated and distributed across the entire network of computer systems on the blockchain. Each block in the chain contains several transactions, and every time a new transaction occurs on the blockchain, a record of that transaction is added to every participant’s ledger. The decentralized database managed by multiple participants is known as Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT).

title: Health Outcomes Liaison - East
description:
Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals , Inc. (Nasdaq ARWR) is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.

Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.

Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI & San Diego, CA, and a state of the art manufacturing facility in Verona, WI. Our employees are nimble, science-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

The Position
The Health Outcomes Liaison (HOL) is a field-based scientific and clinical expert responsible for engaging regional and local payers and healthcare decision makers to communicate the clinical and economic value of Arrowhead’s cardiometabolic RNAi portfolio. The HOL will serve as a trusted scientific partner for managed care organizations, integrated delivery networks, pharmacy benefit managers, and other healthcare decision-makers by facilitating compliant, non-promotional scientific exchange related to clinical evidence, real-world evidence (RWE), health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), and value-based care. This role executes field-level engagement that supports the broader national payer strategy and reports to the Medical Affairs Payer Director (west coast player coach).
This is a highly mobile, customer-facing role that requires more than 60% travel across the assigned geography, including weeknights and weekends as business needs require. The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment, operate with a high degree of agility and autonomy, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced biotechnology environment as organizational priorities shift and the portfolio advances.
Responsibilities
Field Payer Scientific Engagement

• Plan and execute territory level engagement strategy for assigned customers, in alignment with direction set by the Medical Affairs Payer Director and broader Medical Affairs strategy.

• Establish and maintain scientific relationships with payer medical directors, pharmacy directors, formulary committee members, IDNs, ACOs, and other local/regional healthcare decision-makers.

• Deliver scientific presentations to formulary committees and other key healthcare decision-makers (HCDMs), communicating Arrowhead’s health economic model and supporting clinical data, and serve as the primary field-based point of contact for related questions.

• Maintain a consistent and productive field presence across the assigned geography to customer meetings, regional and national conferences as needed.

- Comfort owning a broad scope autonomously, without close supervision.

Benefits

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Lunch Provided in Office

- Team building events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don't. It's a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it's a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How We Use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn't make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. Every transaction across our ecosystem moves money in more than one direction. A collector buys a card, a pack, or a break. A seller gets paid out. A refund or dispute gets resolved. Finance closes the books. The Payments & FinOps team builds the software behind all of it.

As our platforms and payment options grow, the team is moving from platform-specific payment flows to shared capabilities that every storefront and product can use. Payment options now include cards, digital wallets, PayPal, and loyalty currency like FanCash, alongside a growing international footprint. The goal is shared, reliable financial infrastructure so that each new product launch is faster, safer, and cheaper than the last.

The team is based in our Mexico City hub. It partners closely with Engineering, Finance and Accounting, Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and product teams across the U.S. and internationally.

 

The Role

We are seeking a Product Manager to own the Payments and FinOps product portfolio for Fanatics Collectibles. You will define the strategy and roadmap for how collectors pay, how sellers get paid, how money is returned when things go wrong, and how every transaction is accounted for.

You'll work with engineering, finance, and operations to build homegrown solutions or integrate vendors into our stack. You'll balance conversion, cost, risk, compliance, and operational efficiency. You'll be the product owner of the software and work hand in hand with the business owners of each financial operation to measure and improve its quality of service.

This is a high-impact role for a product manager who understands both the collector-facing and back-of-house sides of payments. It suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can balance long-term platform vision with rapid iteration.

The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!
The Pacific Legal Foundation identifies and litigates important legal issues to set landmark precedents that benefit Americans nationwide. Using strategic and principled litigation, communications, and research, PLF battles for freedom in the nation’s capitols, courts, and the court of public opinion.
As a national nonprofit law firm, PLF has brick-and-mortar offices in Sacramento, California; Arlington, Virginia; and Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, although approximately half of the staff work from home offices across the country. Interns work remotely by default, but they can request to work physically in any of PLF’s offices. Interns are expected to work part time (24 hours per week).

Them: State and federal governments and their agencies that overstep their constitutional authority, impose burdensome regulations, and exercise powers that undermine individual liberty and economic opportunity. These actions affect Americans and industries across the country, threatening freedom, innovation, and constitutional limits on government power.
Us: We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation is the nation’s first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty. PLF has an unmatched record in the U.S. Supreme Court, with 18 victories and nearly 200 active cases across the nation.
The Coalitions team extends this work by connecting PLF’s legal and policy expertise with external partners to advance our goals.
There are two verticals of the Coalitions team: Non-Profit Partnerships (NPP) and Private Sector Partnerships (PSP). Non-Profit Partnerships work with other think tanks, foundations, and non-profits to advance our legal and policy priorities and well as manage a grant program. Private Sector Partnerships works primarily with corporations and businesses, trade associations, and industry leaders. This role would work with both verticals but would primarily work with the PSP team.
The private sector relationships we build and maintain give us direct insight into the legal and regulatory challenges facing different industries and help us identify opportunities for PLF to make a difference. Through strategic partnerships, we expand the reach of PLF’s work, develop referral pipelines for potential clients and cases, and identify shared priorities to strategically build policy coalitions. Our goal is to become a preferred legal and policy partner to corporations, trade associations, and their members when government overreach threatens their livelihoods. At PLF, we look for creative, practical ways to make a lasting impact in a constantly changing legal and policy landscape.

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced EEO Specialists with expertise in federal-sector EEO programs, complaint processing, counseling, investigations, ADR, affirmative employment, and EEO program management. This role supports agency EEO Offices by providing technical expertise across the full lifecycle of federal EEO complaints and compliance programs.

This is a remote, contract-based opportunity for professionals with significant federal EEO experience and a strong understanding of EEOC regulations, MD-110, MD-715, and 29 C.F.R. Part 1614.

EEO Counseling & ADR

description:
About the role

When people sign up for Chime, we want to know which marketing efforts brought them in and which ones brought in members who stay and use their account. You will set the direction for how Chime answers that question.

You will be the senior analytics leader for paid marketing. You will decide how we measure a very large paid media budget and how that measurement turns into spending decisions. This is a high-visibility role. Marketing, Growth, Finance and executive leaders will treat your work as the main reference for how marketing performs. You will join the Marketing Analytics team and work across Marketing, Finance, Data Engineering and Data Science/ML.

In this role, you can expect to

• Own the paid performance story. Track spend and results across channels every week. Explain why numbers moved, in plain words that a non-analyst can act on.

• Measure new-member offers. Show whether our sign-up offers bring in better members and whether they are worth the cost. Compare offer groups against fair, matched groups.

• Set the bar for experiments and offers. Define how tests are designed and read, and how we decide whether sign-up offers are worth the cost.

• Improve how we give credit to marketing channels. Find where our attribution rules fall short, propose better ones, and work with Data Engineering to build and maintain them.

• Turn marketing mix modeling into budget advice . Use the output of our Marketing Mix Model to advise Marketing on how to allocate budget across channels.

• Help plan the work ahead. Estimate the likely impact of new marketing ideas so the team can prioritize.

• Use AI to work faster and go deeper. Use AI tools to speed up analysis, check your work, and build things others can reuse.

• Raise the level of the team. Coach senior data scientists, guide contractors and set the quality bar for high-stakes work.

• A Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of experience in analytics or data science, with deep experience in marketing, growth or consumer products

• A track record of setting measurement strategy across several teams, not only delivering analyses within one team

• Deep expertise in marketing measurement: attribution, incrementality, MMM, cost per acquisition and LTV:CAC, including designing these systems from scratch

• Expert-level experimentation and causal inference skills, including knowing when standard methods don’t fit and building approaches that do

• Strong SQL and experience shaping data models and pipelines in large data warehouses (we use Snowflake)

• Advanced Python or a similar language for analysis

• Experience using Marketing Mix Model output to guide budget decisions at significant scale

• Hands-on experience bringing AI tools into analytics work for a team, and good judgment about their limits

title: Regional Director, Solutions Engineering, Enterprise
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

Factory is hiring a Solutions Engineering Manager to build the Enterprise Solutions Engineering team. Our Enterprise Solutions Engineers own the full customer lifecycle, pre-sales and post-sales: discovery, demos, proofs of concept, security and architecture reviews, pilot delivery, and the ongoing adoption and expansion of Factory once a customer is live. You will help build out the team, define how it runs, and own both the technical win and the production outcome for our fastest-growing Enterprise accounts.

You will hire and coach the people who do this work, set the standard for how it is done, and stay close enough to the accounts to do it yourself when it matters. You will work directly with Enterprise Sales leadership, and closely with Product and Engineering. This is a hands-on, zero-to-one leadership role at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering. It suits someone who combines real technical fluency, strong people leadership, and sound judgment under deal pressure.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Build the Enterprise Solutions Engineering team: define the hiring profile, recruit and close the founding Solutions Engineers, and grow the team with the Enterprise pipeline

- Design and iterate the team's operating playbook across the full lifecycle: discovery, pilot scoping, success metrics, security and compliance reviews, production rollout, and ongoing adoption and expansion

- Own the team's technical win rate, time-to-technical-win, pilot-to-production conversion, and post-sales adoption and expansion; report them to GTM leadership and use them to coach the team

- Partner with Sales leadership and Account Executives to run high-quality technical discovery, demos, and proofs of concept that tie directly to customer outcomes

- Carry accounts directly while the team ramps, and serve as the escalation point for complex evaluations, at-risk deployments, and high-stakes Enterprise deals, including CTO, VP Engineering, and Security stakeholders

- Onboard, coach, and develop Solutions Engineers; set clear expectations, career paths, and performance standards, and shorten ramp time with structured enablement

- Act as the voice of the field internally, feeding customer and prospect insight back to Product and Engineering

QUALIFICATIONS

You do not need to meet every requirement to be a strong candidate. If this role excites you and you have related experience, we encourage you to apply.

- 4+ years leading Enterprise Solutions Engineering, Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or customer engineering teams in enterprise software, spanning pre-sales and post-sales, including at least one team you built or scaled from a small starting point

- A strong hiring track record: you know how to source, assess, and close senior technical customer-facing talent

- A strong technical foundation and fluency in modern software development workflows, developer tooling, CI/CD, and AI coding tools

- Proven ability to partner with Sales while protecting technical integrity and customer trust

- Comfort in high-pressure, customer-facing environments; you can take over a stalled evaluation or a struggling deployment and move it forward

- Operational discipline

title: AI Inference Engineer
description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.
We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.
We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.
As data centres become one of the largest and fastest-growing sources of electricity demand, Fuse is expanding into high-performance compute infrastructure at the intersection of energy and AI. We're building the GPU/CUDA performance layer and the inference serving layer at the same time, from scratch, and we're looking for the founding engineer to own the latter. Reporting directly to the CTO, you'll own the layer above kernels and hardware: how models actually get served, scaled and delivered against committed performance targets. Few companies can pair real power delivery with real compute the way Fuse can, which puts inference serving at the heart of our offering.
Responsibilities

• Define Fuse's inference serving strategy and architecture from first principles

• Design and build the serving stack: request routing, batching, scheduling and autoscaling for high-throughput, latency-sensitive inference workloads

• Own model-level optimisation strategy for serving, deciding where and how to apply quantisation, distillation, speculative decoding and similar techniques to improve throughput and cost per token, partnering with the CUDA/GPU engineers

• Make the core software architecture calls on serving frameworks and orchestration (e.g. vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, Triton Inference Server or equivalents)

• Translate throughput, latency and uptime commitments into concrete technical specifications and serving capacity plans

• Act as direct technical owner of inference performance and reliability

• Work closely with the CUDA and GPU engineering teams to integrate custom kernels and hardware performance work cleanly into the serving layer

• Set the standards, tooling and benchmarks this function will run on as it grows

Requirements

• 4+ years building or operating large-scale inference serving systems, or equivalent strong project/industry experience

• Deep, hands-on experience with inference serving frameworks and the techniques used to optimise them (batching, KV-cache management, quantisation, speculative decoding)

• Strong systems thinking, able to reason about the full path from incoming request to served response across a large cluster

• Comfortable working directly with GPU/CUDA engineers to integrate low-level performance work into a serving system

• A track record of making high-stakes architecture calls and owning the outcome

• Comfort operating without a playbook: this is a founding role shaping a new function, not joining an established one

• Bonus: Triton or custom ML inference/training frameworks; autoscaling or capacity planning for large-scale inference; multi-tenant serving or SLA-driven infrastructure; background at a hyperscaler, frontier AI lab or large-scale distributed inference system; Kubernetes/Slurm; interest in energy markets, grid systems or sustainability-focused compute

Benefits

• Competitive salary and eligibility for equity

• Biannual bonus scheme

• Fully expensed tech to match your needs

• Private health insurance

• Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. title: Pressure Vessel Engineer
description:
Role: Pressure Vessel Engineer

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote (U.S.-based)

Travel: Approximately 25% (Domestic & International - may include onsite turnaround support)

Becht is looking for an early to mid-career Pressure Vessel Engineer (PVE) who wants to take the next step in their technical career. We are a world-class, family-owned multidiscipline engineering firm serving the energy sector (refining, petrochemical, and power generation industries), providing expertise that spans both traditional and emerging technology.

Who is Becht ?

Founded in 1964, Becht is a rapidly growing, family-owned multidiscipline engineering firm serving the energy sector (refining, petrochemical, midstream, and power generation industries). We combine deep technical expertise with practical execution to help clients operate safely, efficiently, and reliably.

Becht is a technical leader in pressure vessels, piping, structures, and materials and as such has a major role in international codes and standards, allowing a unique opportunity to both learn and contribute at an industry-wide level. We emphasize multidiscipline problem-solving and collaboration to solve the most challenging design and equipment reliability problems, and our unique network of over 1200 accomplished technical experts spanning all engineering disciplines provides even further opportunities for learning and growth.

All of Becht ’s services revolve around our mission: To Help Our Clients Succeed.

Key Responsibilities

The PVE will be tasked with providing technical guidance for fixed equipment assets from a mechanical engineering perspective. The work will focus primarily on in-service pressure vessels and heat exchangers but may also include piping, tanks, or other associated equipment as the need arises. The PVE will be expected to manage projects from the proposal phase through project completion as the primary point of contact and primary technical resource. Alternately, they may also serve as a technical resource for larger, multidisciplinary projects. Some typical examples of daily project activities for this role are:

• Perform rerate or alteration calculations.

• Perform fitness for service assessments.

• Create, review, or certify fixed equipment repair plans.

• Evaluate bolted flange joints for troubleshooting leakage issues.

This opportunity is for the Mechanical Division within Becht , consisting of more than 40 full time team members. This position is offered as remote work with the need to travel up to 25%, which may include onsite turnaround support.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering or closely related discipline.

• 5-20 years’ experience in a technical role in the refining, petrochemical or power generation industries with a focus on pressure equipment engineering. More senior candidates are welcome to apply as well.

• Experience with rerates/alterations, repairs, fitness for service, bolted flange joints, and ASME Section VIII pressure equipment.

• Experience with the application of industry codes and standards for pressure vessels such as ASME Section VIII, API 579, ASME PCC-1, ASME PCC-2, API 510, NBIC NB-23, etc.

• Experience with field troubleshooting and system walk-downs and the ability to travel to customer sites.

• Experience with turnaround support, planning, & execution.

• Experience with the commercial software COMPRESS or PV Elite.

• Strong grasp of engineering fundamentals and mechanics.

• Self-motivated with strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.

• Capable of managing multiple projects and clients.

Qualifications that set you apart (but not required):

• Professional Engineer licensure in at least one US state.

• API certifications for 510, 570, 571, and/or 653.

• Experience with ASME Section VIII, Division 2 design and construction.

• Experience with advanced analysis such as ASME Section VIII, Division 2 Part 5 - Design by Analysis o

title: Stop Loss Training Lead
description:
Overview
Who We Are
Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform-bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.
Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.
Responsibilities
Ready to be the go-to expert who turns stop loss complexity into reimbursement wins?
Why This Role Matters
Every self-funded plan we serve depends on getting stop loss right, and that starts with someone who knows the contracts inside and out. As Stop Loss Lead, you’re the department’s technical authority, the person who makes sure eligible reimbursements get submitted, tracked, and collected instead of left on the table. Your audits catch problems early, your training makes the whole team sharper, and your process improvements make every claim move faster and cleaner. The stronger your expertise and the quality of your work, the stronger our reimbursement outcomes, our client relationships, and the department as a whole.
What You’ll Actually Do

•
Serve as the stop loss authority: Act as the department’s subject matter expert on administration, reimbursement, and contract interpretation, giving the team a trusted source for answers on complex questions.

•
Dig into contracts and carrier requirements: Review stop loss contracts, plan documents, and carrier requirements in depth to ensure compliance and capture every reimbursement opportunity available.

•
Turn findings into fixes: Spot recurring errors, trends, and process gaps in audit results, develop corrective action recommendations, and partner with leadership to put them in place.

•
Build and coach the team: Onboard new Stop Loss Specialists, create and maintain training materials and standard operating procedures, and deliver coaching and refresher sessions that close knowledge gaps.

•
Improve how we work: Evaluate workflows, lead or support process improvement initiatives, and help roll out new tools and best practices, including testing and validating system updates.

•
Own reporting and audit readiness: Review and help prepare monthly stop loss and reimbursement reporting and carrier submissions, support internal and external audit requests, and keep documentation accurate and current.

•
Step in where it counts: Process stop loss claims and handle related operational work when workflow demands require it, and contribute to special projects that advance department goals.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

• High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred

• 3-5 years of experience in stop loss, self-funded health plan administration, claims, or related healthcare required

• Advanced claims processing and reimbursement experience strongly preferred

• Experience interpreting stop loss contracts and plan documents preferred

• Experience conducting audits, quality reviews, or process improvement initiatives preferred

• Experience training or mentoring team members preferred

Technical Skills:

• Advanced knowledge of stop loss administration, reimbursement processes, and contract interpretation

• Working knowledge of medical terminology and CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding (preferred)

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Ou

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets.
